name: TN Brain · 23 · Friday risk brief - Chloe (Fridays 07:00, needs TN_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN)

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'exposure', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', count(*),
    'critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE details->>'band' = 'Critical'),
    'high', count(*) FILTER (WHERE details->>'band' = 'High'),
    'accounts', count(DISTINCT account_id)) FROM signals WHERE status = 'new' AND type = 'risk'),
 'for_katie', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (
    SELECT s.id, s.summary, a.name AS account, s.details->>'band' AS band, s.details->>'raised_by' AS raised_by
    FROM signals s LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
    WHERE s.status = 'new' AND s.type = 'risk' AND s.details->>'band' = 'Critical'
    ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 3) x), '[]'::jsonb),
 'register_high', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(y) FROM (
    SELECT r.name, r.escalation, r.impact_level, r.account_id, a2.name AS account FROM risks r LEFT JOIN accounts a2 ON a2.id = r.account_id
    WHERE COALESCE(r.status,'') NOT IN ('Closed','Transferred') AND r.escalation ~ 'Level [4-9]' LIMIT 5) y), '[]'::jsonb),
 'week_new', (SELECT count(*) FROM signals WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND status = 'new' AND type = 'risk'),
 'unpushed', (SELECT count(*) FROM signals WHERE status = 'new' AND type = 'risk'
    AND details->>'band' IN ('Critical','High') AND NOT (details ? 'register_item_id'))
) AS ctx;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.user.id, text: $('Build brief').first().json.text, unfurl_links: false }) }}
